text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With so much overtime over the past few 
days, getting back right before curfew has 
basically become routine.
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she's running again today.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Haah, haah, haah.
choice_data_list: （今日もあの子、走ってるかな）

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? Ah, um... Excuse me, is it curfew 
already...?
choice_data_list: お疲れ様

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No... If I don't do at least this 
much... there's no way... I'll ever catch 
up...
choice_data_list: いや、毎日頑張ってるから声かけたくなって

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: My sisters…… are so much, far more――

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Verxina and Vivlos... Both my big sister 
and little sister are strong and fast, 
totally unlike me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ever since we were little, I've never been 
able to catch up.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
No matter how fast I ran, the two of them 
remained so far ahead――
choice_data_list: Still, you want to catch up, don't you?
Still, you want to catch up, right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: でも、追いつきたいと思ってるんだろ？
でも、追いつきたいと思ってるんでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: いつも、遅くまで努力してるじゃないか
いつも、遅くまで努力してるじゃない

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I know it's hard, but... um, I don't want 
to give up. Even if I look stubborn and 
graceless... I can't stand leaving it like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind her halting words, I can sense an 
unwavering resolve. Her running form isn't 
bad either—she can definitely become 
stronger. All that's left is—
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll catch up someday.
I know you'll catch up to them someday.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: 君ならきっといつか、追いつけるよ
貴方ならきっといつか、追いつけるよ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I recall seeing her on my way home from 
work these past few days. Running 
tirelessly over and over, she was showing 
signs of growth, step by step.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The unyielding resolve she held inside was 
definitely translating into results—gazing 
into her wavering eyes, I made sure she 
understood that.
choice_data_list:
So, I think you can have more confidence 
in yourself.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um, well...
choice_data_list: だから、もっと自信を持っていいと思う

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you... very much.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
You might just be trying to be 
considerate, but... I'm really not used to 
hearing things like that... So, um... 
thank you, very much.
choice_data_list:
I'm not just flattering you. I'm sure you 
can catch up.

At the very least, you should be proud of 
your stamina.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Do you really... think so...?
choice_data_list: お世辞なんかじゃないよ、きっと追いつける
少なくともスタミナは誇っていいと思う

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all...! It's just that I'm 
hopelessly lacking in self-confidence... 
Um, your words really did make me, um, 
happy...
choice_data_list: 俺から言われても説得力ないかもだけど
私から言われても説得力ないかもだけど

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I will continue my training, then... If 
you will excuse me...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Stamina, you say...?
choice_data_list:
You'd be able to keep running late into 
the evening every day, right?

You should be able to keep running late 
into the evening every day.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: 毎日、遅くまで走り続けられているだろう
毎日、遅くまで走り続けられているでしょう

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ........I see, so that's how it is.
choice_data_list: 誇っていいと思うよ

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...It's okay to feel proud...
